title: Hearing Aid Battery Cycle Low-Level Alert
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hearingaid:battery
| stats latest(battery_pct) as metric_value by aid_id
| where metric_value<20.0
| sort metric_value
description: Shows hearing aid battery cycle devices that have fallen below a safe battery percentage threshold.
value: Low-level alerts are essential for accessibility gear because failure usually becomes urgent at the worst possible moment.
implementation: Tune the threshold to the minimum safe operating level for each device family.
visualization: Table of devices with current battery percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which hearing aid battery cycle devices are getting low enough to need attention soon.
